_notes: Otaku 网站（FastAPI + SQLite）→ 标准数据集 v3 的映射。
改客户表只改本文件，不动代码——这是解耦的落点。
on_missing 三档：break=关键列缺失就停机 / reject=该行拒绝 / degrade=置空继续。
source_id、关联表的 content_id 一律 break：主键错了会静默产生几十万条重复脏数据。
contents 表没有 updated_at，故 works.source_updated_at 不映射（保持 NULL）。
需要增量同步时，源侧必须补 updated_at 列或触发器；否则只能全量重扫或内容哈希比对。
articles 用 filter 只取已发布，未审核草稿不进数据集。
v2：work_credits 从「整表照搬」改成按 role 白名单过滤——源表 407,949 条里 91% 是原画等工序流水，详情页用不上。白名单与黑名单都写在本文件的 SQL 里，改词表不用改代码、不用发版。

v3：people.source_id 与 credits/cast 的 person_ref 换成前缀键（bgm:/pname:/cname:）。原因：原先 people 存网站自增 id、person_ref 存 Bangumi 人物 id，两套 id 数值会撞车，撞上就把名字挂错人。前缀键把「有 id 能跨源认人」与「只有名字只能站内聚合」分开，且关系行的 person_ref 不再留空——留空就是死链。
v3：没有 Bangumi id 的人名与公司不再丢弃。网站有公司页、有主创名，我们照做：名字归一化后作弱关联键。同名不同人只并列展示、不合并身份。

tables.sql: select ct.content_id as source_id, t.name as name from content_tags ct join tags t on t.id = ct.tag_id

tables._note: v3：主键改前缀键。bgm:=有 Bangumi 人物 id（强关联，可跨源合并）；pname:/cname:=只有名字（弱关联，只做站内聚合）。同一人在关系表与 entities 里都出现时，entities 的行最后写入（_prio 最大），名字以它为准。名字先做空白归一，否则尾空格会把同一个人拆成两条。
tables.sql: select source_id, name, entity_type, bangumi_person_id from (select 'bgm:' || cast(person_id as text) as source_id, min(actor) as name, 'person' as entity_type, cast(person_id as text) as bangumi_person_id, 1 as _prio from content_cast where person_id is not null and trim(cast(person_id as text)) <> '' group by cast(person_id as text) union all select 'bgm:' || cast(person_id as text), min(name), 'person', cast(person_id as text), 1 from content_credits where person_id is not null and trim(cast(person_id as text)) <> '' group by cast(person_id as text) union all select 'bgm:' || trim(cast(bangumi_person_id as text)), name, entity_type, trim(cast(bangumi_person_id as text)), 2 from entities where bangumi_person_id is not null and trim(cast(bangumi_person_id as text)) <> '' union all select 'pname:' || trim(replace(replace(replace(actor, '　', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' ')), min(actor), 'person', null, 3 from content_cast where person_id is null or trim(cast(person_id as text)) = '' group by 1 union all select 'pname:' || trim(replace(replace(replace(name, '　', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' ')), min(name), 'person', null, 3 from content_credits where person_id is null or trim(cast(person_id as text)) = '' group by 1 union all select 'cname:' || trim(replace(replace(replace(name, '　', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' ')), min(name), 'company', null, 3 from content_studios where name is not null and trim(name) <> '' group by 1 union all select (case when entity_type = 'company' then 'cname:' else 'pname:' end) || trim(replace(replace(replace(name, '　', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' ')), name, entity_type, null, 4 from entities where bangumi_person_id is null or trim(bangumi_person_id) = '') order by _prio

tables._note: v3：person_ref 由原始 person_id 改成前缀键，不再留空——留空的关系行在人物页上就是死链。
tables.sql: select cast(content_id as text) as source_id, role, name, (case when person_id is not null and trim(cast(person_id as text)) <> '' then 'bgm:' || cast(person_id as text) else 'pname:' || trim(replace(replace(replace(name, '　', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' ')) end) as person_ref, tier, sort_order from content_credits where (tier = 'main' and role not like '版本:%' and role not in ('发售日','作者','连载杂志','ISBN-10','ISBN-13','册数','链接','出版社','开始','结束','页数','价格','装帧','尺寸')) or role in ('作画监督','总作画监督','演出','分镜','机械作画监督','动作作画监督') order by content_id, sort_order

tables._note: v3：与 work_credits 同一套前缀规则。声优侧 person_id 实测 100% 有值，name: 分支是兜底。
tables.sql: select cast(content_id as text) as source_id, character, actor, (case when person_id is not null and trim(cast(person_id as text)) <> '' then 'bgm:' || cast(person_id as text) else 'pname:' || trim(replace(replace(replace(actor, '　', ' '), '  ', ' '), '  ', ' ')) end) as person_ref, relation, sort_order from content_cast where content_id is not null order by content_id, sort_order
select from_content_id as source_id, to_content_id as related_source_id, relation_type as relation from content_relations
select article_id as article_source_id, content_id as work_source_id from article_content_links
